evidence: Inspected the full body and sole indexed caller. The routine performs a long floating-point path using player_attribute_get_float, attribute_record_value_get, and attribute_record_pointer_get_or_default, but the role of its inputs and final side effects are not established by the caller. Leave unnamed. Source: decompiled/main/main_0056.c:33009-33313; caller decompiled/main/main_0056.c:18169-18173.

The body takes the cache destination and selected index, resolves an attribute-record pointer, maps the record value into a bounded 0..11 dispatch, and invokes attribute-record access/default helpers before storing the resulting context status. Its sole indexed caller is update_contextual_status_cache and passes the entry destination/state. Source: decompiled/main/main_0034.c:14141-14393; caller decompiled/main/main_0034.c:30902-30906.

Inspected the full 405-line body and its caller. It writes several computed values to a caller-owned record and combines numerous context predicates, but the caller is address-derived and there is no resolved string or field schema establishing the record purpose. Leave unnamed. Source: decompiled/main/main_0011.c:11114-11518; caller decompiled/main/main_0011.c:25877-25881.

The body uses the supplied attribute selector to retrieve a player attribute value, passes values through the accepted convert_attribute_value_to_float_div_100 and player_attribute_record_value_adjust_for_category helpers, and writes the selected 32-bit result through the supplied output pointer. Caller invokes it during update_attribute_context_state. Source: decompiled/main/main_0171.c:23620-23937; caller decompiled/main/main_0092.c:14309-14316 (corrected during QA).

Initializes and evaluates multiple fields in the destination record, using context_selected_record_has_supported_status, attribute_context_status_matches, and check_attribute_context_value_supported, then stores the resulting per-attribute flags/status bytes. Its caller is prepare_rtts_training_focus_offer_record, which calls it on the offer record during preparation. Source: decompiled/main/main_0053.c:23554-23801; caller decompiled/main/main_0053.c:22777-22781; domain corroboration tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:11838,11864.
